methods.whenToUse: Use browser sign-in for the provider-hosted MCP server.
methods.guidanceMd: Connect Supabase in the browser and scope the connection to one development project. Write tools start enabled and remain governed by Paperclip's action policies.

warnings: A Supabase account; use a development project and review write actions before connecting production data.
